description:
Open the 'algorithm' (pattern recognition) activity in GCompris. It is usually found under the Logic or Discovery category (icon showing a sequence of shapes). Complete the first 3 levels of the activity. After completing EACH level (when the pattern is full and the success animation/indicator appears), take a screenshot. Save the screenshots as follows:
- Level 1: /home/ga/algorithm_level1.png
- Level 2: /home/ga/algorithm_level2.png
- Level 3: /home/ga/algorithm_level3.png

Finally, return to the main menu or leave the activity open at level 4.
